title: Reviving the cloud bridge from leeward Haleakalā
summary: On April 21, the committee said the white papers on the cloud bridge proposal will be submitted so every member has a copy. A watershed group said the full restoration initiative is slated for about $2.9 million, and it is seeking up to $600,000 to create five new positions. Earlier, the committee approved a limited meeting and site visit to see restoration work and possible work sites.
